Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the vehicle attempted to
move into the adjacent lane. As the lane change began, the front portion of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear quarter
panel of Driver 2's vehicle, which was positioned alongside in the same direction of travel. Both veihcles remained
upright and came to rest on the shoulder without further contact. Driver 2 stated that the sideswipe happened exactly
as Driver 1 described, and two independent bystanders provided statements consistent with that account.
Photographs taken at the scene show scraping and displaced trim along the rihgt side of Driver 1's vehicle and a
matching area of damage on Driver 2's rear panel. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's veihcle at the time and was
observed by responding officers and bystanders. Driver 1 reported neck strain and was evaluated at the scene.
Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as an insured operator on the policy in
force at the time of the collision.
